items.summary: The first release. A message typed into the browser reaches a model and comes back as an answer, with tools, permissions and skills along the way. Nothing before this version worked end to end; everything after it builds on this. Full detail in CHANGELOG.md.
items.content_html:
The first release. A message typed into the browser reaches a model and comes back as an answer, with tools, permissions and skills along the way. Nothing before this version worked end to end; everything after it builds on this.

What’s in it

  • A uv workspace monorepo. Ten small libraries under packages/, one application (hera-core) serving a SvelteKit interface built into the same directory the API serves.
  • One model event union. hera_providers defines everything a model can emit; nothing above it parses text. A malformed tool call arrives as an event, not an exception.
  • Tools as MCP servers. External tools come from ~/.hera/mcp.json, in the same shape as Claude Desktop’s configuration. Hera’s own capabilities — hera__emotion, hera__remember, hera__note, hera__skill, hera__search — are mounted the same way, through the same client.
  • Web search, over DuckDuckGo, no API key required.
  • Skills as SKILL.md packages, selected by code — pinned, then /slash, then keyword retrieval — never left to the model to notice on its own.
  • A git-backed mind. Twelve regions, one file each, in a real git repository at ~/.hera/mind/.
  • Permissions. Allow, deny or ask, resolved by pattern and profile. A confirmation card suspends the turn and waits for a person; “always allow” writes a rule.
  • Chats and projects, with the full event stream persisted so a reload always shows what actually happened.
  • Attachments, including pictures. Read in the browser and sent as a field, never pasted into the message text.
  • Configurable model endpoints. Several can be registered in ~/.hera/config.toml, one active at a time; switching takes effect on the next turn, no restart.

What’s not in it yet

  • No memory — hera__remember and hera__note are wired to nothing and say so.
  • No hera__fetch — she can find a page, not read it.
  • No PDFs.
  • No command palette; ⌘K opens Settings.
  • No mobile layout.
  • Single user, behind a seam meant for more.

Full detail in CHANGELOG.md.
